answer: One defence is Multi-chain gas-history fingerprint: gas spent on four chains, a history no fresh wallet has, and the raven of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: gas spent on four chains, a history no fresh wallet has is fresh per account, and the garden is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the pigment of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
